name: com.gameframex.unity.operationkeyboard.ugui
displayName: Game Frame X Operation Keyboard (UGUI Binding)
description:
UGUI InputField / TMP_InputField keyboard binding package for GameFrameX OperationKeyboard. UGUIInputFieldKeyboardBinder and TMPInputFieldKeyboardBinder attach the keyboard session on focus and detach on blur, reproducing the native event flow (onValueChanged, caret moved to end, EndEdit on confirm). A DontDestroyOnLoad auto-binder polls EventSystem.currentSelectedGameObject at low frequency, so panels need zero changes; com.unity.ugui / com.unity.textmeshpro presence is probed via versionDefines and each binder is stripped when its toolkit is absent. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX OperationKeyboard 的 UGUI InputField / TMP_InputField 键盘绑定包。UGUIInputFieldKeyboardBinder 与 TMPInputFieldKeyboardBinder 在获得焦点时挂载键盘会话、失焦时解绑，并复刻原生事件流（onValueChanged、光标移至末尾、确认时触发 EndEdit）。DontDestroyOnLoad 自举自动挂载器低频轮询 EventSystem.currentSelectedGameObject，面板零改动；com.unity.ugui / com.unity.textmeshpro 经 versionDefines 探测，未安装时对应绑定器代码被裁剪。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
